AgentMessage.description: AgentMessage: Union of LLM messages + custom messages. This abstraction allows apps to add custom message types while maintaining type safety and compatibility with the base LLM messages.

anyOf.description:
Events emitted by the Agent for UI updates.

`agent_end` is the last event emitted for a run, but awaited `Agent.subscribe()` listeners for that event are still part of run settlement. The agent becomes idle only after those listeners finish.

AgentSessionEvent.description: Session-specific events that extend the core AgentEvent

AssistantMessageEvent.description:
Event protocol for AssistantMessageEventStream.

Streams should emit `start` before partial updates, then terminate with either:
- `done` carrying the final successful AssistantMessage, or
- `error` carrying the final AssistantMessage with stopReason "error" or "aborted"   and errorMessage.

cancelled.description: Whether the command was cancelled via signal

fullOutputPath.description: Path to temp file containing full output (if output exceeded truncation threshold)

output.description: Combined stdout + stderr output (sanitized, possibly truncated)

CompactionResult.description: Result from compact() - SessionManager adds uuid/parentUuid when saving

details.description: Extension-specific data (e.g., ArtifactIndex, version markers for structured compaction)

percent.description: Context usage as percentage of context window, or null if tokens is unknown.

tokens.description: Estimated context tokens, or null if unknown (e.g. right after compaction, before next LLM response).

compat.description: Compatibility overrides for OpenAI-compatible APIs. If not set, auto-detected from baseUrl.

thinkingLevelMap.description: Maps pi thinking levels to provider/model-specific values. Missing keys use provider defaults. null marks a level as unsupported.

OpenAICompletionsCompat.description: Compatibility settings for OpenAI-compatible completions APIs. Use this to override URL-based auto-detection for custom providers.

cacheControlFormat.description: Cache control convention for prompt caching. "anthropic" applies Anthropic-style `cache_control` markers to the system prompt, last tool definition, and last user/assistant text content.

maxTokensField.description: Which field to use for max tokens. Default: auto-detected from URL.

openRouterRouting.description: OpenRouter-specific routing preferences. Only used when baseUrl points to OpenRouter.

requiresAssistantAfterToolResult.description: Whether a user message after tool results requires an assistant message in between. Default: auto-detected from URL.

requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessa.description: Whether all replayed assistant messages must include an empty reasoning_content field when reasoning is enabled. Default: auto-detected from URL.

requiresThinkingAsText.description: Whether thinking blocks must be converted to text blocks with <thinking> delimiters. Default: auto-detected from URL.

requiresToolResultName.description: Whether tool results require the `name` field. Default: auto-detected from URL.

sendSessionAffinityHeaders.description: Whether to send known session-affinity headers (`session_id`, `x-client-request-id`, `x-session-affinity`) from `options.sessionId` when caching is enabled. Default: false.

supportsDeveloperRole.description: Whether the provider supports the `developer` role (vs `system`). Default: auto-detected from URL.

supportsLongCacheRetention.description: Whether the provider supports long prompt cache retention (`prompt_cache_retention: "24h"` or Anthropic-style `cache_control.ttl: "1h"`, depending on format). Default: true.

supportsReasoningEffort.description: Whether the provider supports `reasoning_effort`. Default: auto-detected from URL.

supportsStore.description: Whether the provider supports the `store` field. Default: auto-detected from URL.

supportsStrictMode.description: Whether the provider supports the `strict` field in tool definitions. Default: true.

supportsUsageInStreaming.description: Whether the provider supports `stream_options: { include_usage: true }` for token usage in streaming responses. Default: true.

thinkingFormat.description: Format for reasoning/thinking parameter. "openai" uses reasoning_effort, "openrouter" uses reasoning: { effort }, "deepseek" uses thinking: { type } plus reasoning_effort when supported, "together" uses reasoning: { enabled } plus reasoning_effort when supported, "zai" uses top-level enable_thinking: boolean, "qwen" uses top-level enable_thinking: boolean, "qwen-chat-template" uses chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking, "string-thinking" uses top-level thinking: string, and "ant-ling" uses reasoning: { effort } only when the mapped effort is non-null. Default: "openai".

vercelGatewayRouting.description: Vercel AI Gateway routing preferences. Only used when baseUrl points to Vercel AI Gateway.

zaiToolStream.description: Whether z.ai supports top-level `tool_stream: true` for streaming tool call deltas. Default: false.

OpenRouterRouting.description: OpenRouter provider routing preferences. Controls which upstream providers OpenRouter routes requests to. Sent as the `provider` field in the OpenRouter API request body.

allow_fallbacks.description: Whether to allow backup providers to serve requests. Default: true.

data_collection.description: Data collection setting. "allow" (default): allow providers that may store/train on data. "deny": only use providers that don't collect user data.

enforce_distillable_text.description: Whether to restrict routing to only models that allow text distillation.

ignore.description: List of provider names/slugs to skip for this request.

only.description: List of provider names/slugs to exclusively allow for this request.

order.description: An ordered list of provider names/slugs to try in sequence, falling back to the next if unavailable.

p50.description: Maximum latency in seconds at the 50th percentile.

p75.description: Maximum latency in seconds at the 75th percentile.

p90.description: Maximum latency in seconds at the 90th percentile.

p99.description: Maximum latency in seconds at the 99th percentile.

preferred_max_latency.description: Preferred maximum latency (seconds). Can be a number (applies to p50) or an object with percentile-specific cutoffs.

preferred_min_throughput.description: Preferred minimum throughput (tokens/second). Can be a number (applies to p50) or an object with percentile-specific cutoffs.

quantizations.description: A list of quantization levels to filter providers by (e.g., ["fp16", "bf16", "fp8", "fp6", "int8", "int4", "fp4", "fp32"]).

require_parameters.description: Whether to filter providers to only those that support all parameters in the request. Default: false.

sort.description: Sorting strategy. Can be a string (e.g., "price", "throughput", "latency") or an object with `by` and `partition`.

zdr.description: Whether to restrict routing to only ZDR (Zero Data Retention) endpoints.

RpcSlashCommand.description: A command available for invocation via prompt

source.description: What kind of command this is

sourceInfo.description: Source metadata for the owning resource

redacted.description: When true, the thinking content was redacted by safety filters. The opaque encrypted payload is stored in `thinkingSignature` so it can be passed back to the API for multi-turn continuity.

ThinkingLevel.description: Thinking/reasoning level for models that support it. Note: "xhigh" is only supported by selected model families. Use model thinking-level metadata from

VercelGatewayRouting.description: Vercel AI Gateway routing preferences. Controls which upstream providers the gateway routes requests to.

only.description: List of provider slugs to exclusively use for this request (e.g., ["bedrock", "anthropic"]).

order.description: List of provider slugs to try in order (e.g., ["anthropic", "openai"]).
